dome.name: Isenzi selikhupholo
dome.shape.help: Ububanzi nokuphakama kuyilokho kwesimo esiphefumulisiwe (ingaphandle lethovu). Ithovu nekhonkolo kufakwa ngaphakathi kwaso, ngakho ingaphakathi elicacile liba lincane: umphumela uyalinikeza. Udonga oluyisisekelo luwudonga oqondile ngaphansi kwevolo, ngakho ikhupholo liqala liphakame ngaphezu komhlaba.
dome.governed.help: Shiya ibhokisi lingenalutho, nejeneretha iligcwalise: kusukela kusipesifikhi okhethe uma linenani, kungenjalo kusukela kwisibalo sokuqala. Izibalo zokuqala azivela kunoma yisiphi isitendadi. Thayipha isibalo sakho ukuze usedlulisele noma yiyiphi kwalezi.
dome.o.help: Kusikwa ukuvulwa phakathi kwezinhlangothi ezimbili eziqondile ezibheka endaweni ephakathi, kusukela esiyeni sawo kuya phezulu esiphethweni. Ububanzi bayo bulungile ebusweni besimo esiyisisekelo. I-engeli yindawo yayo ezungeze ikhupholo, ngokuphambene nokushayela kwewashi kusukela ohlangothini lwesokunxele lwepulani (0°).
dome.f.name: Igama
dome.read.secondary: kufundwe kwidokhumenti ecaphuna isitendadi, hhayi esitendeni ngokwaso
dome.spec.label: Isipesifikhi esisebenzayo
dome.spec.pick: Khetha isipesifikhi ikhupholo eliyakhelwe kuso. Amanani aso agcwalisa amabhokisi angenalutho, nodizayini ihlolwa ngamanani aphethe njengezinombolo. Ezinye izinqubomgomo zibonakala ukuze wena nonjiniyela wakho nizifunde.
dome.spec.add: Akukho sengezo sesipesifikhi esivuliwe. Engeza “Dome spec: United States” noma “Dome spec: Europe” kusuka eThaleni (Izilungiselelo, Okungezwa) ukuze uletha amanani ezinorma. Kuze kube yilapho, zonke izibalo ziyezakho noma zibalo zokuqala.
dome.spec.counts: Lesi sipesifikhi sibamba izinqubomgomo {primary} ezifundwe emagameni awo ngokwawo, {secondary} ezifundwe kumadokhumenti acaphuna awo, kanye nezinye {none} ezingenamanani esingawafunda. Hlola inani ngalinye ngekhophi yakho yesitendadi, ngokushicilelwa kwaso kwamanje nezilungiso zendawo yakho.
dome.spec.nonecheck: Akukho sipesifikhi esisebenzayo: akukho okuhlolwe ngokusekelwe kunorma.
dome.check.none: Akukho okuphulayo kulolu dizayini okubambe isipesifikhi sona. Lokho akuwona ukuhlolwa kodizayini.
dome.err.sphere: Ingxenye yesféthe ayikwazi ukuba phezulu kunengxenye yobubanzi ({hi} mm); isetelwe lapho. Khetha uhhafu welipsi ukuze uthole ikhupholo eliphakeme.
dome.err.tall: Iphakeme kunokuphindwe kabili ububanzi; isetelwe ku-{hi} mm.
dome.err.flat: Ilele kunengxenye engu-1/20 yobubanzi; isetelwe ku-{lo} mm.
dome.err.opening: Isivulo {n} sashiywa: {part} kufanele ibe ngaphakathi kwebanga {lo} – {hi}.
dome.rule.shell.rebar.spacing.rule: Ibanga phakathi kwezinti, njengoba ikhodi ikubhala
dome.rule.load.standard: Lapho imithwalo yekhephu, umoya nonyikinyiki kuvela khona
dome.problem.opening.high: Isivulo {n} sifinyelela ku-{head} mm, sisondele kakhulu esiqongweni (okungenani {top} mm); sashiywa.
dome.problem.opening.wide: Isivulo {n} sibanzi kakhulu ekhupholweni esiyisiyeni saso; sashiywa.
dome.problem.shell.thin: Igobolondo elingu-{shell} mm lishiya indawo encane yensimbi ngokuvikelwa okungu-{cover} mm ohlangothini ngalunye.
dome.problem.footing.narrow: Ivolo lesisekelo ({footing} mm) lincane kunekhonkolo elimi phezu kwalo ({base} mm).
dome.problem.footing.wide: Ivolo lesisekelo libanzi kunokuthi iradiyasi yekhupholo ivumele; asikho isilabhu sesakhiwo esenziwe.
dome.problem.headroom.none: Ukuphakama okucacile esikhungweni ({clear} mm) kungaphansi kokuphakama okucelwe ({headroom} mm).
dome.problem.stress.high: Ukucindezeleka okukhulu kwethini ({stress} MPa, okungakaphindwa) kungaphezulu kwamandla ekhonkolo ({strength} MPa).
dome.fc.bearing: Ingcindezi ngaphansi kwevolo lesisekelo (ikhupholo, udonga oluyisisekelo nebhimu)
dome.fc.hoopsteel: Indawo yensimbi yokuqina okukhulu ezungeze ikhupholo
dome.q.steel: Insimbi egobolondweni, kudonga oluyisisekelo nakuvolo lesisekelo
dome.report.title: Ikhupholo
dome.bim.note: Ukubeka emodelini kubhala ikhupholo emodelini ovulekile esitezini sawo sokuqala, njengezakhi ongazikhetha, uzihlele, futhi uzilondoloze kufayela le-IFC. Isinyathelo esisodwa esithathwa yi-Hlehlisa; ukubeka futhi kuyashintsha ikhupholo elinegama elifanayo.
dome.bim.nolevel: Imodeli ayinalo izinga lokumisa ikhupholo kulo. Vula noma qala imodeli kuqala.
dome.bim.place.label: beka ikhupholo
dome.bim.remove.label: susa ikhupholo
dome.cad.note: Dweba ipulani nesigaba kubeka ikhupholo kumdwebo njengamasekhele, amagatsha, imigqa ehlanganisiwe, umbhalo nezilinganiso ezingqimbeni ze-DOME-. Isinyathelo esisodwa esithathwa yi-Hlehlisa. Imigqa ayilandeli izinguquko ezizayo: susa bese udweba futhi. Ifayela le-IFC liyimodeli ye-3D.
dome.cad.draw.label: dweba ikhupholo
dome.cad.remove.label: susa umdwebo wekhupholo
